_comment: Herbalist Lionett, north of the Town Crier towards the seaweed shore. Standing talkable-NPC shape (miller.json): townsfolk, collisionLayer 97 without Action(2) so no aura targets it, role creature + speed 0, xpFactor 0. Offers and turns in `a-healthy-brew`; teaches FirstAid on its turn-in. Dialogue from the PO's quest sheet. entityType VillageHealer is placeholder art. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: Lionett

lines: Ohh ... a new face around here.

options.text: Do you have work for me?

lines: Indeed I do! I'm about to brew a special tea that helps you regain focus.
If you help me gather the ingredients, I'll let you in on the recipe.

grants.line: I'd hoped you'd say that. You need to harvest seaweed from the shore up north. 8 strands should suffice.
I'll teach you how to use it, so you can use it in the future if you're short on focus.

lines: You'll find seaweed to the north, close to the shore. Once you're there, use your Harvest aura to gather it.
